description: This PHP source file defines the 'Theme' controller class within the OpenCart admin system, responsible for managing themes in the admin interface. It includes methods for listing themes, editing theme details, handling form submissions, and loading view templates related to theme management.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Controller class for managing themes within the OpenCart admin interface, providing functionalities to list, edit, add, and delete themes.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the main theme management page, including listing themes and handling pagination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of themes, likely in JSON format, for AJAX calls or API responses.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view with the list of themes, including pagination and filters.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Prepares and displays the form for adding or editing a theme.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Loads and displays a template based on the given path, handling default and extension templates.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving (adding or editing) theme data, processing POST requests, validating permissions, and updating the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected themes, including permission checks and database operations.
